narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with actual kinetic exchanges and strategic infrastructure strikes. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these conflicts, driving safe-haven flows.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; overweight cash and short-duration Treasuries.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is flowing into oil and energy assets as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, with SPR releases actually signaling bullish supply tightness. Diplomatic progress claims are contradicted by active military escalation, reinforcing structural oil scarcity.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's selloff mirrors broad risk-off moves, not crypto-specific weakness, as institutional de-risking dominates. Whale accumulation and MicroStrategy buying suggest dip-buying, but capital flows are driven by macro fear, not fundamentals.
narratives.trade_implication: Short Bitcoin futures; long volatility via options on crypto ETFs.
